summary.text: Heather Stephenson is the Republican candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Amy Tagliareni.

paragraphs.text: Stephenson was also the Republican nominee for District 42 in 2024, when she lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Heather Matson.
She advanced from the Republican primary for the seat on June 2, 2026.
